profile.description:
Hello, My name is Shannon. I love horses! I have 4 of my own:
Bella
Bek
Flashy
Star!
My favourite is Bella! (The horse in my Bg) Not to be mean! But I have had her sence I was 9! Now i'm 15! I love all my horses! They all rock! But the other horses I only got this year 2008! I am and equestrian sports girl! I do jumping,dressage,eventing
Mosty jumping! Horses are the most amazing animal! AND WE NEED TO STOP HORSE SLAUGHTER!!! IT IS CRUEL! I think people that kill horses do drugs! BECAUSE IT IS STUPID! NO JOKE! I KNOW SOMEWAY SOMEHOW! THERE IS A WAY TO STOP HORSE SLAUGHTER!!

 Things I will do:
Accept friend invites
Send you pictures

Things I won't do:
Sub 4 Sub??
Give you  my email


Thank you!
EquestrainSportsGal:)
